# The android-all-instrumented jars the unit suite loads, for ONE Robolectric version.
# Read by .github/scripts/robolectric_prefetch.sh. The `-iN` suffix and the build ids change between
# Robolectric releases, so this table is keyed by version: the script FAILS when the version in
# gradle/libs.versions.toml differs from the line below. To bump Robolectric, update both: take the
# names from DefaultSdkProvider in the new release (default SDK = app targetSdk, plus every
# `@Config(sdk = [..])` under app/src/test).
